preconditions.description: The length of string A must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of string B must be between 1 and 10,000.
Both A and B must be strings.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(-1) if len(A) != len(B) else True
postconditions.description: If the lengths of A and B are not equal, the output must be -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min_steps) if len(A) == len(B) else True
postconditions.description: If the lengths of A and B are equal, the output must be the minimum number of steps required to transform A into B.
